invention.ref_zh: 东汉打虎亭等庖厨画像可见蒸笼类器具

popularization.ref: Stacked bamboo zhenglong become standard dim-sum and household steamers
popularization.ref_zh: 竹制叠层蒸笼成为点心与家用标准蒸具

locations.place_label_en: Dahuting, Mixian, Henan, China (Eastern Han kitchen mural)

locations.place_label_zh: 中国广东（后世点心蒸笼传统中心）

sources.title: Bamboo Steam: From Kitchenware to Cultural Icon — HKU MMEA

notes: 更早的陶甑可追溯到新石器时代；本条目专指竹编叠层蒸笼。韩信发明等传说缺乏实证，主年份取东汉图像证据。
notes_en: Ceramic yan steamers are far older (Neolithic). This entry covers stacked bamboo zhenglong. Legends crediting Han Xin lack evidence; the primary mark follows Eastern Han mural evidence.
summary_zh: 竹制叠层蒸笼约在汉代厨房图像中可见；后世成为中式蒸点与家常蒸煮的标准器具。更早的陶甑另有渊源。
summary_en: Stacked bamboo steamers appeared in Han-period kitchen imagery and later became standard for Chinese steamed dishes. Older ceramic steamers are a separate lineage.
